summary: Iter13 backend tests for Workflow Budget -> Appels de fonds wizard: 15/15 PASS. Covered N-1 previous-year-expenses aggregation, Budget approve/revoke/edit-lock, preview-from-budget (draft->400, structure, schedule, reserve on call#1 only), generate-from-budget persistence, frequency validation (1/2/3/4/6/12) and date math (_add_months), RBAC owner=403 on preview/generate/approve, regression on list endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: fund_calls.py L342: distribution sum may slightly differ from call total_amount due to per-line rounding before per-owner aggregation; tolerated in tests with 5.0 EUR threshold. Consider rounding only at owner-level for cleaner reconciliation.
fiscal.py L342 (previous-year-expenses): comment 'invoice_je_ids' set is never used; cleanup possible.

fiscal.py: previous-year-expenses includes ALL invoices in date range as 'amount_invoices' AND ALL class-6 manual entries as 'amount_manual'. Risk of double-counting when invoices also generate journal entries (since invoice JEs aren't excluded by fund_call_id alone). Worth verifying with closed-FY data; currently no closed FY in DB to validate this concretely.
fund_calls.py: ReserveFund.distribution_key_id - if provided but no key matches, falls back silently to tantiemes (acceptable but undocumented).
RBAC: confirmed owner gets 403 on POST /api/fund-calls/preview-from-budget, generate-from-budget and /api/fiscal/budgets/{id}/approve - good.
seed_data_creation: All test data prefixed TEST_iter13_*; cleaned up after each test (budgets revoke+delete, fund_calls delete, owner user delete).
